label: couchbase-cli
type: the umbrella cluster-administration CLI binary shipped with Couchbase Server, whose ~130 subcommands (bucket-create, server-add, setting-cluster, user-manage, xdcr-setup, backup-service, ...) cover most of the same ground as the Web Console and REST API. Distinct from cbstats/cbepctl/mctimings/mctestauth (per-node diagnostic and protocol tools, not cluster administration) and from cbbackupmgr (a separate binary with no couchbase-cli equivalent).
evidence: couchbase-cli is a command line tool that can be used to manage Couchbase Server from the command line rather than the graphical interface (Web console).
authenticatesVia auth-mechanism:username-password / auth-mechanism:x509-certificate (couchbase-cli.md CERTIFICATE AUTHENTICATION section)
note: PAID-DOWN WHOLE-CORPUS PROMOTION DEBT, the round's largest: 35 of this round's own 127 files use tool:couchbase-cli as a relation subject or object (52 files any-mention), and the whole umbrella tool - the subject every one of its ~130 reference pages implicitly assumes - had never itself been promoted, across every prior round that touched a couchbase-cli subcommand page. Joins the promoted CLI-tool family (cbbackupmgr, cbcollect-info, cbexport, cbimport, cbq-shell, cbsqlitedump, cbstats) as the family's highest-recurrence member. See reconciliation.md round 29 for the companion finding: couchbase-cli's own ~51 individual subcommand ids, minted independently by ~40 single-page extraction agents as tool:couchbase-cli-<subcommand>, are NOT promoted alongside it - a subcommand is not a tool, and this namespace's established convention (one member per binary) is deliberately not extended to cover them.
relates_to_competency_question: What is the umbrella CLI tool that most couchbase-cli-*.md reference pages are describing one subcommand of?
